PLAN "12-Week Moderate-Intensity General Fitness (Post-MI Safe)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general fitness safely at moderate intensity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation and Technique" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A (Intro)":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x20 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Cardio + Core (Low Impact)":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 3x6m rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          dead_bug 2x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body B (Intro)":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
